rules: Real media only; every file traces to Concepts-R2/hold-the-mic/media, Prototype-26/media or Prototype-4/media (see source on each entry). No SBI or NSE media.
Nothing is upscaled; no derived file exceeds its source dimensions.
year is filled only where the record supports printing it; Datamatics and Himalaya carry year:null on purpose (see yearNote).

Spoken words shown as hers: only the four verified Datamatics cues. Every other transcript is a draft: show only while playing, with the chip 'Draft transcript, awaiting her approval' (Dorby: 'Draft transcript and translation, awaiting her approval').
Clips: H.264 High yuv420p 720x1280 30 fps, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo ~128k, moov before mdat (faststart). Loudness target -16 LUFS integrated (EBU R128) within 0.5 LU; true peak at or below -1.5 dBTP.
Stills cut from video are 720 px wide: render at <= 792 css px (video rule). Photographs: srcset/sizes so naturalWidth >= 1.5 x clientWidth at 1440 and 390.
'-mono' files are plain luma greyscale (no contrast or brightness baked in), so they are safe under the still-state CSS filter grayscale(1) contrast(.82) brightness(1.1).
